inputs.prompt: Re-render this simple 3D blocking frame as a finished film frame. Keep the composition exactly: the same camera angle, horizon, and street, and the car at the same position and the same size in the frame as the red box car, seen from the same side. Replace each colored block with the building or object it stands for. The car is an unbadged design with a plain, unbranded grille and no hood ornament. A cyberpunk night scene, photoreal. The red block car becomes a sleek, angular black future sports car with glowing cyan light strips. The street becomes a dense megacity street at night in heavy rain: towering buildings covered in glowing neon signs and holograms with no readable words where the colored blocks are, tall lamp posts with flickering neon where the poles are. Deep puddles reflecting magenta and cyan light, steam rising from vents, streaks of rain. No text, no logos, no badges.
